events.title: Woodstock Festival's 57th Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, an iconic moment in counterculture history, took place 57 years ago.

angles.name: Summer of Love vibes
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since half a million gathered for three days of peace and music. What's your favourite memory or track from Woodstock?

events.title: Elvis Presley's 49th Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 49 years since the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Forty-nine years on, the King's legacy still reigns supreme. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the influential lead singer and songwriter of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single 51st Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's profound single 'Imagine' was released in the UK 51 years ago, coinciding with his 'Shaved Fish' album.

angles.name: Imagine's message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since 'Imagine' landed in the UK. A song that continues to resonate with its powerful message of peace.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the 64th anniversary of the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Which Bond theme tune gets your heart racing, or which film is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles' legendary co-founder, John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incredible musical and cultural legacy of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's 35th Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost the incomparable showman and Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years have passed, but Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?
